source_analysis.reusable_architecture: Introduce a public-facing practice, explain how its physical implementation works, connect concrete components to a wider civic meaning, and end by synthesizing practical and communal value.
copyright_risk_notes: Do not reuse a station mural, celadon, pottery, ceramic shards, Korean American identity, named artists, Flushing, Queens, or source history.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Cities authorizing carefully managed evening street markets
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Identify underused evening streets; propose temporary markets; explain modular operation and benefits; answer access and cleanup concerns; recommend measured pilots.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Schools replacing selected paved areas with instructional rain gardens
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Identify runoff from paved schoolyards; propose planted collection areas; explain design and curricular benefits; address maintenance concerns; recommend site-specific implementation.
